editorial.blurb: A luxe-yet-laid-back Chicago gem where impeccable service, creative cocktails, and bold Italian-American fare make every meal feel like an experience.
editorial.insiderTip: Call ahead if running late for your reservation—the team will hold your table and the GM personally ensures you're taken care. Ask your server (especially if it's CICI!) for Creole-Italian recommendations if you love bold, flavorful food.
